change.issue: Potential native authority TOCTOU: mutable host.native_session_live or host.native_approve attributes could be replaced by callbacks between dispatcher checks; if the verifier changed to one returning True after lease revocation, authorization continuity is not assured. Host route registry identity was likewise not pinned.
change.fix: Capture the native session verifier, native approval callback and route/port registries at execution entry; freeze risk category before callbacks; deny authority or registry identity substitution across all admission, consent, readiness, owner and result stages. Detect session verifier substitution during its own callback, and reject changes during capability advertisement.

change.limits: Source-level hardening only. Native host must still bind real SID/token, session lease revocation checks at owner pre-effect boundaries; no Windows runtime proof, and callback mutation restored between observations cannot be detected by identity checks alone.
